title: Notices of Funding Opportunities
html:
All NIH Notices of Funding Opportunities (NOFOs) can be accessed from the NIH Grants & Funding website. To view a list of NOFOs issued or sponsored by NIDCR please visit grants.nih.gov.

If you are interested in learning about NIDCR specific Grant Programs, please visit our Grant Programs page.

If you need to contact someone about a specific Grant Program, please visit our Staff Contacts page.

Highlighted Topics 

NIH is using highlighted topics as a way to inform the research community about particular areas of scientific interest to NIH. Highlighted topics include timely, new, and/or emerging research priority areas for applicants to consider when they are developing an investigator-initiated application in response to one of the NIH Parent Funding Announcements or another broad NIH opportunity on Grants.gov.

If you would like to learn about highlighted topics of interest to NIDCR, please visit the Highlighted Topics page on Grants.gov and select “NIDCR” in the “Participating ICOs” dropdown menu.
